narrative.details:
A finer cap you may never see. From the pristine hide of the beast, our expert crafters will create the most phenomenal hat a prestidigitator could ever hope to don!

Fifty gold pieces along with the listed items and your head shall be graced with the Cap of the Scarlet Savant:

*The pristine hide of the Beast.

*Frayed abomination stitchings.

*Arcane crystals.

*Enchanted scarlet thread.

BEHOLD!
narrative.objectives: In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread.
narrative.offerRewardText: Astounding! It must have taken weeks to gather those components... and how did you find a pristine hide?!?Enjoy the cap, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText: Unless you've got everything I need, you're wasting my time.
